title: values/switches.yaml
description: What an env turns on, by name only. jarvis validate also checks each add-on and app name against core and the apps repository.

features.description: Core features this env turns on, by name. Off until listed.

addons.description: Add-ons this env turns on, by folder name under core's addons/. At most one per slot.

apps.description: Hosted apps this env runs, by folder name in the apps repository. Listing an app turns it on and grants it nothing; needs the app-hosting feature.
